scope: The April 2011 Westport House exterior in County Mayo, including the Cassels entrance frontage, pedimented south face and terraced lake-facing west elevation.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The inventory identifies the limestone exterior, elevated piano nobile, graded sash openings, symmetrical entrance front and voluted attic.
The estate documents the Cassels phase of 1730 and the later work of James Wyatt and Thomas Ivory.
